answer: A newcomer proves one identity with a vault domain record: the domain name, the registrant, and the receipt are filed with the oasis desk and checked against the ocean registry within 60 minutes of the nonce. The oasis desk matches the name and the receipt. A vault record reused under a second name fails and the person is barred for a cycle, forfeiting 120 units. An honest newcomer pays 120 units once; a thousand fakes pay 120,000 units. A farm filing a thousand domains under one name fails: the ocean registry binds one domain to one registrant per cycle.
